programme.title: Sarah And Duck
programme.desc: Sarah, a polite and curious 7-year-old English girl, embarks on lots of little adventures with her best friend - a lovable duck named Duck.

programme.title: Thomas and Friends
programme.desc: With the Sodor Search and Rescue Centre up and running the race is on to become the Sodor Search and Rescue Engine. Thomas takes Bertie on a rail adventure and soon runs into trouble on the Shake Shake Bridge.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying the street food, backpacking’s a blast – until they lose their passports.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table – they’re not animals! But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyone’s got a wild side!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a pet! To show them how much work they’d be in for, Dad transforms his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu with a taste for trouble.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: It centers on the greatest potato superhero as he battles Evil Pea among the supermarket aisles.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he’s lost it! He’s having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The squirrels help Happy look for it but no one can find the tooth anywhere.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are rushing around the clubhouse in a very excited manner, so Duggee tries to show them how to enjoy things at a slower pace, and encourages various ‘slow down’ activities.

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel...,
programme.desc: Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and – most of all – to do things!

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Four explorers on a Global adventure. Xuli, Kyan, Lars, Foz. They are the Go Jetters...!

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Four explorers on a Global adventure. Xuli, Kyan, Lars, Foz. They are the Go Jetters...!

programme.title: Go Jetters

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: OKIDO is a comedy adventure, science-educational series following a curious, adventure seeking and unruly monster called Messy as he finds the answers to everything a 3-5 year old child wants to know. Why do things fall down and not up? Where do echoes come from? Messy goes on incredible adventures with his two best friends, Zoe and Felix to find the answers. They are helped along the way by the bonkers science trio Zim, Zam and Zoom. Together they will fly to the moon, shrink to the size of atoms and fly on the back of a giant butterfly.

programme.title: Andys Baby Animal...
programme.desc: Find out about baby animals from different locations around the world. Take a wild journey of discovery with Andy narrating. Learning about how they learn, find food and lots more.

programme.title: Swashbuckle
programme.desc: A game show where children compete to win back the jewels belonging to Gem. Captain Sinker, and pirates Cook and Line are out there to stop the kids from getting the jewels back. If all five jewels are retrieved, one of the nasty pirates will walk the plank, into he ships mess.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husbands murder by the rapist.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten. His father loses at cards, and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons 7 fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Paul Chang Chung plays Dr. Ho, who decides to move to a backward island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his missing father.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Beggar Su and his brother train incessantly to defeat the brutally powerful thief called Centipede.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. She asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead.

programme.title: The Lady Is The Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal.

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women give birth to baby girls by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him.

programme.title: Clans Of Intrigue
programme.desc: One day, when the heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, Gong from the Holy Water Palace accuses Chu of stealing the holy water and using it for various murders.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-An
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor. He is besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister. The Prime Minister is corrupt, causing them to revolt the throne.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Kuo (Leslie Cheung) falls for the Dragon Maiden while learning the art of swordplay, but as master and pupil they cant get married.

programme.title: Whose Baby Is In Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. His class helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching.

programme.title: Cat Vs Rat
programme.desc: When young martial artist The Rat unwittingly rescues the emperor from a gang of thieves, it sets in motion a chain of events that see him compete for his life against The Cat.

programme.title: The Tiger And The Widow
programme.desc: In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel by Jin Yong, havoc breaks out when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased master.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: What began as the sweet reunion of two high school friends quickly deteriorates into a deranged erotic nightmare when Rose takes a shine to former classmate Fang and her new fiance!

programme.title: Return Of The One-Armed...
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and report to officials, while heroes emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: Beloved heroine Cheng Pei-Pei again plays a swordswoman who teams with a swordsman named Drunken Cat to battle a corrupt Buddhist monk.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Action maestro Chang Cheh tells the story of Chin Feng, who meets the beautiful Ting Hung while on the run for accidentally killing an arrogant bully.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks and forcing a pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong’s disciples and frames him for robbery and murder.

programme.title: Arjuna In Switzerland
programme.desc: "Arjuna in Switzerland" is a culinary travel show featuring Chef Juna exploring Switzerlands natural beauty and culture, tasting local dishes, and sharing unique experiences.

programme.title: Arjuna In Switzerland
programme.desc: "Arjuna in Switzerland" is a culinary travel show featuring Chef Juna exploring Switzerlands natural beauty and culture, tasting local dishes, and sharing unique experiences.

programme.title: City Of Desire
programme.desc: Sandra returns to Macau after having been in Canada for the last twenty years. Her father is ill and the business is being passed on to her, but she is taken aback to discover that the family business is prostitution.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong’s biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching’s wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighboring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Chan Tin Mei (Sammi Cheng) and Ho Bun (Alan Luk)s son passes away abruptly at just three years old due to congenital heart disease. Suffering in unfathomable pain over the loss, Mei resists having another child. One day, Mei finds out that they can become a foster family.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-Storey...
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. When the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior, he vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Tales From Occult: Body and Soul
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns to feature three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist and a chef.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: This family drama is about an 11-year-old boy who befriends his landlord, nicknamed Old Fox, and learns from him how to survive in a rapidly changing world as well as things his poor father would never be able to teach him.

programme.title: Wu Xia
programme.desc: Martial artist Liu hides his identity and lives in a remote village with his wife Ah Yu and their two sons, but somehow gets embroiled in a bizarre murder case.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: A wealthy entrepreneur goes undercover with an Interpol agent to protect a new invention, the Seed of God, from falling into an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: I Corrupt All Cops
programme.desc: There was a dark age when corruption and bribery were the order of the day in Hong Kong. One day, comes brave individuals who are determined to end corruption with the founding of Hong Kongs anti-corruption bureau.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon
programme.desc: Crippled Ho came to Hong Kong as an illegal immigrant in 1963 and ruthlessly carved an empire from the chaotic underworld of drug dealers and corrupt police that ruled the city under notorious detective Lee Rock.

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: A gambling addict and her anti-gambling husband face relationship challenges when she must return to her old ways after criminals target her family.

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: Directorial debut of Man Lim Chung, who spent 3 years filming this documentary about the life and filmmaking philosophy of Ann Hui, one of Hong Kong’s greatest filmmakers. It traces Hui’s life story and her 40-year career’s ups and downs using film footages, candid conversations with Hui, and interviews with her collaborators, family and friends.

programme.title: Schemes In Antiques
programme.desc: When an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Young And Dangerous: Reloaded
programme.desc: In this remake of “Young and Dangerous”, Chan Ho Nam and his three buddies of the Hung Hing triad gang strive to fight for their own justice, further expanding their power in the triad and becoming a new legend...

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Actor Lau Wai-Chi has a huge following of devoted followers and is always keeping an eye on his rivals. After accepting to play the lead in a modest indie drama, Lau begins the laborious process of mastering the acting skills for the role.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: After seeing a warning video about an e-ghost on YouTube, Cherry begins to encounter many mysterious incidents. She must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world.

programme.title: We Are Family
programme.desc: Jia-cong, who came from a broken family, and Pei-yi, a single mother who had little talent on the entertainment road, founded a company that can provide "rental family" services.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Chen and his partner Guan are legendary navigators, but in the process of helping a girl Xiao Yu, they must also face their own problems.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Wei Long travels to HK from Shanghai to pursue her education. As she struggles financially, she becomes her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks in a life of depravity.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence, landslides, and put a town nearby are at stake. Will the authority blow up the tunnel?

programme.title: Man On The Edge
programme.desc: The triad gang leader assigns Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: CGTN Documentary
programme.desc: Launched on Jan. 1, 2011, CGTN Documentary is the only Chinese TV channel to broadcast documentaries in English 24/7. The channel broadcasts over 1,000 episodes of new programs each year, including top quality documentaries such as “A Bite of China”, “Wild Wonders”, and the 100-episode “A History of China”. CGTN Documentary is an ideal platform for people around the world to learn about Chinas past and present, and is dedicated to promoting the best of Chinese documentaries.

programme.desc: Hosted by award-winning ABC News reporter Gio Benitez, "I Survived a Crime" takes viewers on a journey into the experience of being a victim of a sudden crime, from the moment those attacked first perceive the danger through the potential long-lasting effects. Using surveillance and cell phone footage captured during the crime, the series follows individuals going about their daily lives who were confronted with a dangerous situation and forced to make a quick decision on how to protect themselves or their families.

programme.title: Mega Fights
programme.desc: HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features Baby Bull, Juan Diaz, (34-2, 17 KOs) battling Paul Malignaggi, aka Magic Man, (26-2, 5 KOs) in a junior welterweight title bout from the Toyota Center in Houston, Texas, USA, on August 22, 2009.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Paul Vs Carlos
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is then-undefeated Paul Williams defending his welterweight championship against Carlos Quintana. The fights result ultimately ended up being what might be considered one of the biggest upsets in boxing.

programme.title: Judo For The World
programme.desc: In this episode, St. Petersburg hosts the season finale where well see the best Judo from some of the sports biggest superstars. Plus, we speak with Academy Award winning actor Adrian Brody and get his impressions of attending his first big Judo event, and we follow 3 Georgian warriors who came to St. Petersburg to finish the year in style.

programme.title: FS MMA: Sonnen Vs McKenzie
programme.desc: MORE MMA MONDAY: Outspoken MMA superstar Chael Sonnen matches up with veteran Tim McKenzie of Stockton, California. McKenzie entered the bout with a record of 10-3, having won his last two fights by TKO over Doug Marshall and Mike McGuinnes. Sonnen was in between stints with the UFC at the time, having won his first two fights with Bodog leading into this one. He would go on to face the likes of Anderson Silva, Jon Jones, and Rashad Evans in the UFC before collecting wins over Rampage Jackson and Wanderlei Silva with Bellator.
